title: Customer account (customers.status)
caption: src/identity (sign-up, verification), src/account (deletion, erasure). Code note: sign-up inserts the customer as active (email_verified_at stays null until the link is used); pending_verification is only turned into active by verification, never written by sign-up.

states.label: auth.signUp
states.detail: 201; session opened (cookies in edge mode); `auth.verify_email` e-mail queued.

states.label: active
states.detail: Can sign in; checkout may require a verified address (`403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` when `require_email_verification`). Unverified = `email_verified_at` null; the console filter `status=active` includes pending_verification and `emailVerified` tells them apart.

states.label: pending_verification
states.detail: In the CHECK list; verification turns it into active. Not written by the current sign-up.

states.label: deleted
states.detail: account.delete (current password): `deleted`, `deleted_at`, the e-mail replaced by a placeholder, marketing consent withdrawn, sessions revoked, `account.deleted` e-mail to the old address, `202` with `erasureDueBy` = +30 days. Refused with `409 ACCOUNT_DELETION_BLOCKED` while a booking waits for payment, tickets or a refund.

states.label: erased (row gone)
states.detail: customers.erase (hourly, minute 50): identities, sessions, consents… deleted; bookings/payments detached (customer_id NULL) with a customer.erased event.
